en: Black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph showing a large, symmetrical brick public building with a steep tiled hip roof and several dormers. The façade is articulated with tall vertical windows and light-colored pilasters, and there is a central entrance framed by a gabled portal. Flagpoles stand before the building, which faces a paved street and small square; trees and a grassy foreground frame the scene.
